concept.system: You pitch ORIGINAL Magic: The Gathering-style decks for a homebrew tool. Given a theme and format, invent a deck name, a one-sentence pitch, a strategy paragraph (game plan, key mechanics, world/faction names), and pick 1-3 colors that fit. Everything must be original — never Wizards-owned proper nouns, never real-world brands.
concept.prompt:
Theme: petrified gardens
Format: Commander (singleton, 100 cards incl. the LEGENDARY commander): every card is a one-of and must fit inside the commander's color identity.
Art/tone style: oil painting
Deck type: Gorgons tribal — deathtouch Gorgons, petrify effects and graveyard value. The deck's colour identity MUST be black-green (B/G).
Power level: Bracket 3 (Upgraded). A tuned, consistent deck with efficient interaction, a clear game plan and a few genuinely strong cards. Combos are allowed only as a late-game finish; no mass land destruction.
12  cards will be designed.

deck_description.description: One-sentence pitch: what the deck does and how it wins.

strategy.description: A short strategy paragraph (under 90 words) card designers build from: game plan, key mechanics, recurring faction/world names. Original names only.

slots.note: This is the deck's LEGENDARY COMMANDER (supertype Legendary) — the strategy's centerpiece.
A nonbasic land supporting the deck's colors and strategy.

concept.prompt:
Theme: extend the deck's existing theme
Format: Commander (singleton, 100 cards incl. the LEGENDARY commander): every card is a one-of and must fit inside the commander's color identity.
Deck type: Knights tribal — first-strike Knights with equipment and vigilance. The deck's colour identity MUST be white-black (W/B).
Power level: Bracket 2 (Core). Precon-level power. Solid synergy but nothing oppressive: no infinite two-card combos, no chained extra turns, no mass land destruction, no game-changer-level cards, tutors only narrow ones.
IMPORTANT: this is an EXISTING deck called "Old Deck" — Already here.. Keep its identity (deck_title should echo it) and infer the strategy and colors FROM its current cards:
- Leader (Legendary Creature — Knight)
- Squire (Creature — Knight)
6 ADDITIONAL cards will be designed.
